source.name: LIV Golf: Callaway Golf announces new equipment partnership with Rahm and Legion XIII
source.note: All six team-page partners: Callaway, Greyson, Openbank, Rolex, New Era, SowaYoga. This announcement has no full date on the page ('19 months ago' when fetched 2026-10-03); AmateurGolf.com dated the same announcement 2025-03-08.

source.name: Golf Business News: LIV Golf's Legion XIII team announce apparel partnership
source.quote: Clothing and sportswear brand Greyson has announced a multi-year apparel sponsorship of LlV Golf League team Legion XIII
source.note: 'LlV' capitalisation copied as printed on the page.

source.name: Banco Santander press release: Santander to introduce Openbank in US
source.quote: He and his team will wear an Openbank logo on their shirt during all competitions beginning at the Masters in Augusta (USA).

source.name: LIV Golf - Legion XIII team page
source.note: Rolex logo in the team page's partner bar (logo image only, so no quotable text). Jon Rahm is a Rolex Testimonee since 2016: rolex.com/en-us/rolex-family/golf/jon-rahm.

source.name: LIV Golf: New Era Cap and LIV Golf announce multi-year partnership
